text:
jia: Quick idea - add a lightweight error-injection harness to the switchover coordinator so we can exercise rollback/fallback flows in staging. want to surface tradeoffs before I build a prototype.

sam: do you mean targeted injections during canary windows (e.g. delay/drop to the new pool) or broader chaos experiments?

jia: targeted only. simulate probe failures, delayed responses from the new-variant pool, and skipped KV warmups for some sessions. not full chaos.

maria: we have an offline simulator in eng-runtime but it doesn't hit the real rollout controller. having the coordinator trigger injections would catch orchestration gaps. i'm pro.

noah: tradeoffs to call out: (1) must avoid accidental impact on production clusters, (2) avoid complicating coordinator critical path, (3) ensure alerts are filterable. staging-first is a must.

jia: plan is staging-first, feature-flagged, RBAC gated. also a "decision-only" mock mode for CI that never calls the runtime.

elaine: telemetry: injected runs need explicit tagging so evaluation pipelines and alerting can ignore or analyze them separately. otherwise we pollute SLO dashboards.

sam: API sketch: coordinator accepts an injection_profile when creating a rollout. e.g.

```yaml
injection_profile:
  id: "staging-slow-newpool"
  target: "new_variant_pool"
  kind: "delay"
  delay_ms: 250
  apply_pct: 15
  window: "10m"
```

sam: ActionPlane (runtime) subscribes to the profile and enacts controls locally. keeps Decision vs Action boundary clean.

maria: separation is good. eng-runtime implements sandboxed shims to enforce limits. also require fail-open semantics: if injection subsystem errors, rollouts proceed without injection unless explicitly in a test-run.

noah: auditability: if injection causes a rollback, persist rollout.metadata.injection = true and injection_id so postmortems can filter. also emit injection events into the event stream.

elaine: telemetry contract suggestion: emit injection.start and injection.end events with tags {profile_id, rollout_id, operator, mode}. all induced probe failures should include `cause: injected` tag.

sam: implementation note: prefer event-sourced injection events instead of mutating core rollout fields. side-channel events let us replay and reconstruct decisions later.

maria: ops requirement: add an operator kill-switch that tears down any active injections immediately. operator-stop should be honored by DecisionPlane and ActionPlanes.

jia: agreed. default operator abort => immediate teardown + optional forced rollback. also provide a soft-abort that stops further injection but lets current requests finish.

noah: two useful modes: "mock-decision" where coordinator runs decision logic but action calls are faked, and "live-inject" which actually exercises runtime. mock helps perf/algorithms testing; live helps integration.

elaine: alerting hygiene: create a dedicated alert rule that suppresses paging for deployment runs tagged with `injected=true` unless the signal exceeds a high-severity threshold. keeps noise down.

sam: long-term refactor: split coordinator into DecisionPlane (policy, evaluation) + Orchestrator/Agent that delegates to region ActionPlanes. simplifies testing and lets us implement injection as a plugin on ActionPlanes.

maria: DEV tasks: add a sandboxed injection adapter in eng-runtime, implement RBAC + feature-flag in controller, and add operator kill-switch endpoints.

jia: OWNERs: sam (API), noah (events/audit), elaine (telemetry/alerting), maria (runtime shim). i'll write an RFC with these pieces.

deploy-bot: deploy started: coordinator-injection-proto v0.1 -> staging at 1768801280 :construction:

sam: i'll prototype the API and a small CLI to create injection profiles this week.

maria: i'll sketch the shim and make it fail-safe (sandbox, token gating).

noah: i'll draft the event schema: injection.{start,stop,abort} with ISO timestamps + rollout_id + profile_id. will add replayable event IDs.

elaine: i'll add the telemetry tags and the alert suppression rules to the alerts repo.

jia: i'll open RFC and link it here. thanks all. :raised_hands:

deploy-bot: deploy finished: coordinator-injection-proto v0.1 -> staging at 1768801389 :white_check_mark:
